attributes.action: Ensure fairer economic policies for working taxpayers and pensioners
attributes.additional_details:
Millions of low-paid workers can not afford private pensions prior to the automatic workplace enrolment in 2016 relying on the State Pension. Many face tax on amounts over the basic threshold, despite having contributed to the system for 35 to 50 yrs.

The welfare system must ensure that work always pays. Benefits should not exceed what an individual earns through employment.

IImmigration remains a central public concern, while strain is placed on public services and resources.
attributes.background: We want the Government and Parliament to reform national policies to better protect low-paid working-class taxpayers, restructure the welfare and state pension systems, and ensure political representation genuinely reflects the concerns of the British public.

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do.

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what specific action you would like the Government or Parliament to take.

You may be interested to read the measures set out in the 2026 Budget: https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/budget-2026-document
